symptom: Frontend TypeScript production build failed with TS2554 and TS7009 in Dashboard and Login.
evidence: Both pages imported a React component named Error, shadowing the native Error constructor introduced by a lint repair.

root_cause.summary: A component import shadowed the native error constructor in the caught-value fallback.

resolution_evidence: Frontend lint and production build pass; final Compose services are healthy and UC-03 observations pass.
reusable_resolution: Use globalThis.Error when a local Error component shadows the native constructor.
prevention: Run production TypeScript build after every lint-only source correction.
